COMPANY OVERVIEW 

 HexArmor® is a leader in developing some of the most advanced PPE solutions for your eyes, hands, arms, and body. At HexArmor®, we believe safety is not a luxury – it’s a necessity. Since day one, we have worked hand-in-hand with our customers to design innovative, high performance PPE that helps ensure workers return home in the same condition they arrived.  Our mission is to provide the protection that makes this possible, for every worker, everywhere.

 POSITION SUMMARY 

 HexArmor is seeking a motivated and curious Software Engineering Intern to join our growing Atlanta-based Software Engineering team. This internship provides hands-on experience in full-stack software development, with opportunities to contribute to real-world projects using technologies such as Ruby on Rails, React, and JavaScript.

 Working alongside experienced engineers and cross-functional teams, you will gain exposure to the full software development lifecycle, strengthen your technical and problem-solving skills, and contribute to applications that support business operations. The ideal candidate is eager to learn, enjoys solving challenges, and thrives in a collaborative, fast-paced environment.

 LOCATION 

 1 Glenlake Parkway – Atlanta, GA 30328

 The team operates on a hybrid schedule, with in-office collaboration on Tuesdays and Thursdays.

 JOB DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES 

• Assist in designing, developing, testing, and maintaining web-based applications using frontend and backend technologies, including Ruby on Rails and React. 

• Collaborate with software engineers, product managers, and other cross-functional partners to understand business needs and develop technical solutions. 

• Participate in the software development lifecycle, including planning, coding, testing, debugging, and deployment activities. 

• Support the development and integration of APIs, databases, and user-facing application features. 

• Troubleshoot technical issues, identify opportunities for improvement, and contribute to solutions that enhance application performance and reliability. 

• Participate in code reviews, team discussions, and Agile development activities to gain exposure to software engineering best practices. 

• Learn and apply software development standards related to code quality, security, documentation, and testing. 

• Contribute to assigned projects while taking ownership of deliverables, communicating progress, and seeking feedback to support continuous learning. 
 
 REQUIREMENTS 

• Currently pursuing a bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field. 

• Foundational understanding of software development concepts, programming principles, and object-oriented programming. 

• Experience with or exposure to programming languages and web technologies such as Ruby, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, or similar technologies through coursework, personal projects, or previous experience. 

• Basic understanding of databases, SQL, and/or API concepts. 

• Strong analytical, critical thinking, and problem-solving skills. 

• Ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a team environment. 

• Strong communication, organizational, and time-management skills. 

• Willingness to learn new technologies, accept feedback, and adapt to changing project priorities. 
 
 PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS 

• Exposure to Ruby on Rails, React, or other modern web development frameworks. 

• Familiarity with relational databases such as PostgreSQL or MySQL. 

• Experience with version control tools such as Git or GitHub. 

• Basic knowledge of software testing, debugging, and quality assurance practices. 

• Familiarity with Agile methodologies or project management tools such as JIRA or Confluence. 

• Exposure to cloud platforms such as AWS or Azure. 

• Previous software development experience through internships, academic projects, or personal projects. 
 
 WHAT YOU’LL GAIN 

• Hands-on experience contributing to real software development projects with meaningful business impact. 

• Exposure to full-stack development, modern technologies, and industry-standard engineering practices. 

• Opportunities to collaborate with experienced software engineers and cross-functional business teams. 

• Practical experience with problem-solving, debugging, code reviews, and Agile development processes. 

• Professional development, mentorship, and opportunities to strengthen technical and communication skills. 
 
 COMPENSATION 

• Competitive Hourly Wage 

 HexArmor is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating a workplace where all individuals are treated with dignity and respect. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, or gender identity), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law.

 At HexArmor, we believe diversity in people and ideas makes us stronger. We are committed to attracting and retaining a diverse employee workforce honoring people’s experiences, perspectives, and cultural backgrounds. As one HexArmor community, we strive to create and maintain a working environment that is welcoming, inclusive, and impartial. If you require a reasonable accommodation during the application or interview process, please let us know.

 ** Employment offers are contingent upon an E-Verify check and the successful completion of a pre-employment drug screen and background check **

Software Engineering Intern  

 Job Overview: 
Perform basic to intermediate software tasks to help support the production of high-quality software products.  This includes collaborating on a project team using an agile software development process to help plan and produce software that meets Minitab design and coding standards.

 Skills/Qualifications: 
•    Familiarity with web development technologies such as HTML/CSS, JavaScript/ES6/JQuery and knowledge of web framework such as React.js, Angular, Node.js or VueJS
•    Knowledge of C++, C#, and/or Python
•    Experience with source control systems such as Git 
•    Experience with Docker or Kubernetes is a plus
•    Familiarity with testing frameworks and the ability to write and maintain unit tests
•    Ability and initiative to work effectively both independently and as a member of a development team
•    Ability to solve basic technical problems

 Candidates Should expect the following:  

• A structured intern program offering social activities and networking opportunities with other interns as well as Minitab colleagues including our CEO. Ever taken a tour of Beaver Stadium? Movie night or pool party with your intern colleagues sound like fun? How about a meet up at our state of the art on site gym? Lunch with the CEO? 

• Substantive projects that make an impact to Minitab’s business and customers.  

• A professional and highly welcoming working environment where you will take away key skills and experience.  
 
 MUST be available to work onsite at our Minitab Corporate Headquarters in State College, PA. 

 Remote work is not an option for this position.  

 **Interviews will take place in late January 2027** 

 Qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.  

 This position is ineligible for visa sponsorship.  

 To be considered for this role, you must be legally authorized to work in the United States and not require sponsorship for employment now or in the future.

Description
 The Cloud Infrastructure Engineering Associate will assist in development, implementation, and supporting related services and solutions for consulting clients. This position will participate in building customer- focused relationship with clients to identify business challenges and develop specifications and requirements to arrive at the best solution. 

 Roles and Responsibilities/ Essential Functions: 
 
• Work as a member of the HBS Cloud Architecture Team (CAT) as a contributor that provides consultative and proactive project support to Heartland Business Systems’ (HBS) account base. 
• Obtain knowledge on a variety of technologies and platforms as directed by your leader and customer demand. 
• Provide support, maintenance, and administration for customer environments. 
• Contribute to, when possible, the process to assess, develop, implement, optimize, and document security technologies and processes, data protection, cryptography, key management, identity, and access management (IAM) within SaaS, IaaS, PaaS, and other cloud environments. 
• Cross-Education / Mentoring of other Heartland Interns, Engineers, and related personnel. 

 Requirements
 How to qualify: 
 
• Enrolled in a university majoring in an IT-related field.  
• Minimum 3.5 GPA.  
• Maintain an outcome focused mindset  
• Have strong prioritization skills  
• Always be a team player  
• Carry a professional attitude and respectful demeanor  Why HBS?

 Performance – HBS is driven to achieve exceptional results in all aspects of our business. 
 Respect – HBS Team Members demonstrate personal integrity and professionalism when dealing with all internal and external contacts. 
 Innovation – HBS is passionate to serve our internal and external customers with innovative solutions to enhance their success. 
 Development – HBS is committed to developing ourselves and each other in ways that support and improve the performance of ourselves and our business. 
 Excellence – HBS takes great pride in all we do and strive for excellence always. 

 What you can expect from HBS: 
 
• Competitive Compensation Package (May include but not limited to: Bonus, Incentive, Commission, Fair Wage, Retirement Plans, Benefits with HSA Compatible Plans)  
• Growth Opportunities  
• Community Involvement   
• Personal Development  
• Employee and Family Celebrations  
• Green Initiatives  
• Personal Time Off  
• Work Life Balance  
• Recognition and Awards  Day in and day out, you will be a part of a collaborative, innovative and award-winning team that will make you a better professional. Choose HBS today! 

 Heartland Business Systems is an Equal Opportunity Employer - Including Disabled and Veterans.

Job Description: 
 
 Full Stack Developer Internship Overview: We are looking for enthusiastic, motivated, and capable computer science majors willing to learn what it takes to thrive in a real-world manufacturing environment.  The ideal candidate should possess a strong interest in the modern techniques of software development and have excellent communication skills. The Developer Intern will work with a development team to learn and practice the Agile SCRUM methodology for delivering software. The Developer Intern will work with the team to deliver a software solution that fulfills requirements as defined by a Business Area.
  
 * This 2027 Summer internship is intended for students entering their junior year of college in fall 2027 and finishing up the internship the summer prior to their senior year (designed to be a 2-summer program, but we will also accept applications for students entering their senior year of college). The internship is paid and is scheduled to begin in mid-May and conclude in early August. 

 Requirements and Qualifications: 
 
• Pursuing a bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related area  
• Experience or Knowledge of: 
• .Net, C# 
• JavaScript 
• CSS, HTML 
• Willingness to learn new languages and technologies   
 This internship will be during the summer of 2027, lasting approximately 12 weeks, and will include training, development, and collaboration with the appropriate Business Users.
